listing.aiSummary: Adds a collection of hullmod-based skins for vanilla and Traverser Bureau ships.

description:
A mini skin pack by Yogurt Fox, translated by Myco (well, there isnt a lot to translate :))

Safe to add mid-save, not safe to remove.

Adds skins as seen above, including a variety of vanilla ship plus one traverser bureau ships.

Should generally be compatible with everything, does not require DA or traverser to use. Please note that the skins are applied by hullmod and not magic paint system.

discordPostHtml:
From Yogurt Fox with even more Apogee color schemed skin and DA colored skin for various vanilla ships, to be applied via hullmod.

https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Fox_bar_skin_pack/releases/download/1.0/Fox.bars.skin.package.zip

Includes a series of vanilla ships plus a traverser bureau ship, does not require TB or DA to run.

Safe to add mid save, not safe to remove.
aiDescription: Provides a mini skin pack that applies new visual styles to various vanilla ships and one Traverser Bureau ship. The skins are implemented using hullmods rather than the magic paint system.
